tasks.label: 1 · Subir o banco (Docker)
tasks.command: open -a Docker; docker compose up -d db && docker compose ps

tasks.label: 3 · Abrir o banco no navegador (Adminer :8080)
tasks.command: docker start modular-adminer 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name modular-adminer --network modular-perfumes_default -e ADMINER_DEFAULT_SERVER=db -e ADMINER_DESIGN=dracula -p 8080:8080 adminer; sleep 2; open http://127.0.0.1:8080
